text: APPROVE. The patch splits the loop body into `MergeReportRows` and `AddBranchTotals`, which lowers `GatherLcov`'s complexity well under 15. The catch's `continue` becomes an equivalent `return`, and the `CHA0004` pragma is kept around the catch, so behaviour is unchanged. I couldn't build it here, so I'm assuming the `ref found`/`ref hit` locals and the new method names don't clash with anything in the file.
